snippet.title: BlueLine - Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 Wishlist BlueLine on Steam: bit.ly/steam-blueline

A visual interactive story about Blue, who is expected to be successful at work, be a good partner, and at the same time... be happy.

✨ Key Features:
• Story-Rich, Introspective Visual Interactive Narrative
• Cinematic Hand-Drawn Animatic Art Style
• Atmospheric, Award-Winning Original Score by @campuszerox
• Deep Exploration of Mental Wellness, Burnout, and Personal Boundaries

🔗 Follow Our Journey:
🌐Website: playblueline.com
🌐Social Media (X / Instagram / Facebook / TikTok / Bsky): @playBlueLine 

#BlueLine #GameDev #IndieDev #GameTrailer #VisualNovel #VisualNarrative #InteractiveFicion #StoryRich #GoingPlacesStudio
